bullets.text: An elderly couple staged a sit-in protest at the Avadi sub-registrar office alleging officials aided a land grab worth 25 crore rupees, and the district team should monitor this fraud probe.
The Murasu cyclone impact delayed north-bound trains via Andhra Pradesh by four hours near Ponneri, and the district team must watch for transport disruptions.
The Ministry of Electronics and IT released indigenous foundation models under the IndiaAI Mission, and our office should track adoption of these models.
StartupTN Chairman Singai G. Ramachandran stated that over fifty percent of Tamil Nadu's sixteen thousand registered startups are women-led, and the portfolio team should support this growth.
A new report shows ninety-seven percent of Indian professionals want to learn more about AI, and our department should watch for training opportunities.

stories.title: Over 50% of startups in Tamil Nadu are led by women, says StartupTN Chairman
takeaways: StartupTN Chairman Singai G. Ramachandran stated that 50.8 percent of over 16000 registered state startups are women-led.
This milestone demonstrates strong inclusive growth in the state startup ecosystem overseen by his portfolio.
